title: Cockpit performance report
description: Canonical `cockpit.performance/v2` JSON output. The document is either one complete capture (the value stored under `cockpit.performance.<name>` in `IntegrationTestWidgetsFlutterBinding.reportData`, produced by `CockpitPerformanceReport.toJson()`) or the complete export bundle written by `performanceJson()`/`exportPerformanceJson()` (produced by `CockpitPerformanceHtml.fullJson()`, which embeds every capture with raw Perfetto and CPU payloads included). Durations are microseconds, byte sizes are bytes, and timestamps inside frames/events are engine- or VM-epoch microseconds unless a field name says otherwise. Missing metrics are unavailable, never zero: empty phases omit their aggregates, `fps` is omitted without a strictly increasing frame cadence, and `dropped`/`drop*` counts are present only when something was actually dropped.

utcTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant with an explicit `Z` timezone.

bundle.description: The complete canonical export bundle for every completed capture in one test, produced by `CockpitPerformanceHtml.fullJson(...)`, `performanceJson()`, and `exportPerformanceJson()`. Unlike the single-capture `report` shape, each embedded report keeps raw Perfetto bytes and CPU sampling arrays.

label.description: Capture label: the report's `step` id when present, otherwise `Capture <index + 1>`.

startup.description: Cold-start milestones. The harness clock starts immediately before the app builder runs, so native process launch time is outside these values.

source.description: Origin of the timing clock; `harness` for the Dart test harness.

appMs.description: Milliseconds spent building and mounting the application.

firstMs.description: Milliseconds from harness clock start until the first pumped frame.

readyMs.description: Milliseconds until the configured initial bootstrap pump completes.

analysis.description: Bounded derived projections computed from the retained events of one capture. Original events remain unchanged in `report.events`.

hotspots.description: Operation hotspots aggregated by event category and name, ordered by total duration.

count.description: Total observed events for this category/name pair.

timed.description: Events that carried a positive duration.

total.description: Sum of durations in microseconds; omitted when zero.

p90.description: 90th percentile duration in microseconds; omitted when zero.

max.description: Longest observed duration in microseconds; omitted when zero.

gcAnalysis.description: GC pause analysis derived only from real GC timeline events. `count: 0` means the retained timeline exposed no verifiable GC marker; it never means a zero-cost collection cycle.

count.description: GC events found in the retained timeline.

timed.description: GC events with a measurable pause duration.

total.description: Total timed pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

p50.description: Median pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

p90.description: 90th percentile pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

max.description: Longest pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

report.description: One complete bounded performance capture produced by `CockpitPerformanceReport.toJson()`. Frames and events arrays appear only when non-empty; retention boundaries are explicit in `dropped`.

durationUs.description: Exact capture duration in microseconds; equals `finished` minus `started`.

build.description: Flutter build mode. Debug timings are diagnostic only; profile timings support performance decisions; release timings require a native release harness.

mode.description: Retention mode: `light` keeps a smaller bounded window, `profile` retains the fuller capture.

frames.description: Retained frame timings ordered by strictly increasing `i`; omitted when empty.

events.description: Retained VM timeline and plugin events; omitted when empty.

step.description: Explicit step id this capture is attributed to.

plugins.description: Bounded statistics for each explicitly registered performance plugin; omitted when empty.

dropped.description: Explicit retention boundary. Present only when at least one count is positive; aggregates then describe the retained sample only.

frames.description: Valid frames observed but not retained.

events.description: Valid events observed but not retained.

summary.description: Aggregate metrics over the retained frames. Each phase's `n` equals `frames`; when frames were dropped these are retained-sample aggregates, not whole-capture percentiles.

frames.description: Number of retained frames represented by this aggregate.

jank.description: Frames whose total span exceeded the frame budget.

fps.description: Observed frame cadence from strictly increasing engine timestamps; omitted when fewer than two such timestamps exist. No wall-clock estimate is substituted.

gc.description: Observed collections; present only when at least one generation count is known.

phase.description: Percentiles for one frame phase. With no samples the numeric aggregates are omitted rather than reported as zero.

n.description: Retained frames used for this phase.

bud.description: Frame budget in microseconds this phase is compared against.

miss.description: Samples over budget. The vsync phase reports zero by definition.

cacheMax.description: Peak retained raster-cache occupancy across frames.

frame.description: One frame from Flutter's frame timing pipeline. Timestamps use an engine-defined epoch, are not DateTime values, and may be negative in synthetic data.

i.description: Frame index within the capture; strictly increasing across `frames`.

t.description: Engine timestamp of vsync start in microseconds.

w.description: Wall-time timestamp of raster finish in microseconds, same engine epoch.

s.description: Total frame span in microseconds; the value jank is measured against.

n.description: Engine frame number when the runtime exposes one.

bs.description: Raw build-phase start timestamp in microseconds; absent when the host provides only aggregate durations.

bf.description: Raw build-phase finish timestamp in microseconds.

rs.description: Raw raster-phase start timestamp in microseconds.

rf.description: Raw raster-phase finish timestamp in microseconds.

event.description: One bounded VM timeline event or plugin instrumentation event.

c.description: Timeline category, for example `Dart`, `GC`, `Embedder`, or a plugin category.

t.description: Timestamp in microseconds on the same monotonic clock the VM timeline uses.

d.description: Duration in microseconds; omitted for instant events.

p.description: Trace phase marker such as `B`/`E`/`X` when retained.

pid.description: Process id copied from the VM trace.

tid.description: Thread id copied from the VM trace.

src.description: Instrumentation source, normally a registered plugin id. VM-originated events leave this absent.

u.description: Source URI supplied by the instrumentation source.

a.description: Event arguments as a plain JSON object; omitted when empty.

memoryReport.description: Bounded process-memory timeline captured alongside frame timings. RSS values come from the platform process API and include Dart, engine, native, and mapped memory under that platform's accounting rules.

dropped.description: Samples observed but not retained; omitted when zero.

memorySummary.description: Aggregate memory pressure over the retained samples.

avg.description: Mean RSS bytes over retained samples.

t.description: Offset from capture start in microseconds.

peak.description: Process peak RSS bytes; at least `rss`.

archiveInfo.description: Metadata for an append-only JSONL event archive. The report retains only a bounded in-memory window while the complete capture streams to chunks; use `manifest` and `chunks` as artifact paths instead of expecting event payloads inline.

mode.description: `lossless` keeps every record; `low` enforces a bounded queue with counted drops.

manifest.description: Path to the chunk-set manifest; the single entry point for the complete stream.

chunks.description: Chunk file paths; omitted when empty.

events.description: Archived event records; omitted when zero.

frames.description: Archived frame records; omitted when zero.

records.description: Total archived records; omitted when zero.

bytes.description: Total archived bytes; omitted when zero.

drop.description: Records dropped by a `low` backlog bound; omitted when zero.

errors.description: Archive write errors; omitted when zero.

pluginStats.description: Bounded statistics for one explicitly registered performance plugin. The event list in `report.events` remains the source of truth; this projection exposes attribution and cost without loading every event. A failed plugin is isolated and reported here; it never fails the measured action.

span.description: Begin/end span events; omitted when zero.

drop.description: Events dropped by retention limits; omitted when zero.

bad.description: Events rejected as invalid; omitted when zero.

trunc.description: Events truncated by payload bounds; omitted when zero.

dur.description: Total span duration in microseconds; omitted when zero.

max.description: Longest span duration in microseconds; omitted when zero.

cat.description: Accepted events grouped by plugin category.

devtools.description: Bounded projections of the VM data exposed by Flutter DevTools. Unsupported data is an explicit state; an absent metric is never zero. The `f`/`s` arrays of CPU profiles, allocation traces, and Perfetto `data` bytes are retained only by complete exports (`fullJson`, HTML) and omitted from compact integration-test output.

source.description: Data origin, for example `vm` or `unavailable:web` on web where VM timeline data does not exist.

alloc.description: Opt-in allocation call stacks for explicitly selected VM class ids.

dbg.description: Bounded VM Debug-stream events; metadata only.

dropLog.description: Log records dropped at the retention limit; omitted when zero.

dropDbg.description: Debug events dropped at the retention limit; omitted when zero.

cpuProfile.description: Dart VM CPU sampling profile. Stack entries in samples are indexes into `f`.

depth.description: Maximum stack depth retained per sample.

n.description: Total samples the VM reports for the window.

dropped.description: Samples dropped by retention limits; omitted when zero.

s.description: Stack as indexes into `cpuProfile.f`; omitted when empty.

trunc.description: Present only when the stack was truncated at the depth bound.

heapPoint.description: One heap usage reading; `use` never exceeds `cap`.

heapProfile.description: Before/after isolate heap state, bounded allocation classes, and an optional sampled usage trend.

dropped.description: Classes dropped by the class bound; omitted when zero.

samples.description: Sampled heap usage trend ordered by non-decreasing `t`.

interval.description: Sampling interval in milliseconds; omitted when no samples were taken.

drop.description: Usage samples dropped by retention limits; omitted when zero.

reset.description: VM-native timestamp of the last allocation accumulator reset.

gcAt.description: VM-native timestamp of the last service-triggered GC.

id.description: VM class id; present when needed for opt-in allocation tracing.

allocBytes.description: Accumulated allocated bytes since the last reset.

allocCount.description: Accumulated instances since the last reset.

t.description: Offset from capture start in microseconds.

gcProfile.description: GC pauses derived only from real GC timeline events. Presence proves verifiable GC events; absence never means zero-cost collections.

n.description: GC events found in the retained timeline.

timed.description: GC events with a measurable pause duration.

total.description: Total pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

p50.description: Median pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

p90.description: 90th percentile pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

max.description: Longest pause in microseconds; present only when at least one pause is timed.

newUs.description: Total new-generation pause in microseconds; present only when positive.

oldUs.description: Total old-generation pause in microseconds; present only when positive.

gpuProfile.description: Evidence-only GPU and shader counts from the retained timeline. These are signals, not decoded GPU timing.

time.description: Total matched duration in microseconds; omitted when zero.

isolateProfile.description: Before/after isolate state around the capture, including an all-isolate inventory and bounded lifecycle events.

dropB.description: Isolates omitted from `allB` by the bound; omitted when zero.

dropA.description: Isolates omitted from `allA` by the bound; omitted when zero.

dropE.description: Lifecycle events dropped by the bound; omitted when zero.

isolateStats.description: One bounded snapshot of an isolate's runtime health.

sys.description: Whether this is a system isolate.

isolateEvent.description: One lifecycle notification from the VM Isolate stream.

rpc.description: Extension RPC registered by the event.

timelineProfile.description: Timeline recorder and stream metadata observed from VM Service.

recorded.description: Streams actually selected for this capture.

displayProfile.description: Display timing metadata from the engine. An unknown refresh rate stays absent; a 60 Hz fallback is never guessed here.

hz.description: Effective refresh rate in hertz for the selected view.

rebuildProfile.description: Bounded DevTools-compatible `Flutter.RebuiltWidgets` evidence; collected only with explicit opt-in, never by default.

frames.description: Per-frame rebuild counts ordered by strictly increasing frame number.

dropF.description: Frames dropped by the bound; omitted when zero.

dropE.description: Entries dropped by per-frame bounds; omitted when zero.

unknown.description: Entries whose source location stayed unresolved; omitted when zero.

e.description: Flutter's compact wire form: a flat even-length `[locationId, count, ...]` sequence. Counts are strictly positive; the pairing is enforced by the Dart model, which rejects odd lengths.

n.description: Total rebuilds observed for this location.

vmRuntimeProfile.description: VM runtime identity and isolate inventory. Descriptive evidence only; missing VM fields stay absent.

vmMemoryProfile.description: Before/after process-memory accounting trees from VM Service.

t.description: Offset from capture start in microseconds.

vmMemoryNode.description: One node of the VM process-memory tree. A child never exceeds its parent's size; the Dart model bounds depth at 8 levels and 512 total nodes.

drop.description: Children omitted by the node bound; omitted when zero.

allocationTrace.description: Opt-in allocation call stacks for one explicitly selected VM class; never collected without an explicit class id.

vmLogEvent.description: One bounded VM Logging-stream record. Text is copied only when the VM already includes it; no extra object fetch is performed.

vmDebugEvent.description: One bounded VM Debug-stream event with only the source context already present in the notification; variable evaluation stays an explicit debugger operation.

perfettoProfile.description: Opt-in raw Perfetto traces. Base64 payloads stay absent from compact output and appear only in complete exports.

kind.description: Which VM tracing surface produced this trace.

data.description: Base64 Perfetto protobuf bytes (bounded to 64 MiB); complete exports only.
